Method of Attack: Exploitation of Oracle WebLogic Server deserialization vulnerability CVE-2019-2725 to gain full server access
Installation of ransomware to encrypt files and delete shadow volume copies
Issuing ransom notes with unique keys and payment instructions
Use of additional ransomware (GandCrab) on already infected servers
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CVE-2019-2725 deserialization vulnerability in Oracle WebLogic Server
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note text with unique extension (e.g., p67867)
Commands: vssadmin.exe Delete Shadows /All /Quiet & bcdedit /set {default} recoveryenabled No & bcdedit /set {default} bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures
